remarks: Charming on the Outside, Exceptional on the Inside!! Welcome to this completely renovated Cape Cod-style home set on a spacious, level and lush property in Norwalk's sought-after Williams Street neighborhood. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath gem perfectly blends timeless charm with modern luxury. The renovation, begun in 2022 and just completed, includes a brand-new HVAC system, gas heat as well as central air, upgraded electrical panel, 50-gallon hot water heater, whole-house humidifier and dual-zone smart thermostats. The 2023 custom kitchen features quartz countertops, soft-close cabinetry, new stainless steel KitchenAid appliances, propane gas stove, large Silgranit sink, and new Andersen sliding doors and windows with UV protection. Both bathrooms (2025) showcase Moen and Kohler fixtures, a walk-in shower, deep soaking tub and custom storage. Throughout the home are solid-core doors with sleek black hardware, gleaming hardwood floors, fresh paint and an acoustical soundproofing wall between the first-floor bedroom and living area for added comfort. Outside, enjoy a Trex deck overlooking a large backyard perfect for entertaining, plus a deep 1-car garage with custom built-ins and a well-equipped basement with laundry, stainless sink, and sump pump. Conveniently located near I-95, Merritt Parkway, beaches, Rowayton, Westport, SoNo, shopping, restaurants, golf & yacht clubs and train stations. Every detail has been designed for today's lifestyle - move right in and fall in love!
